brief: A small round spirit of warm rose-coloured mist with a dozen tiny hands, like a starfish, bustling in: one hand pushing a book towards you, one a spoon, one setting a foot on a path; the Vetāla seated on a root beginning a tale with a raised finger; Dādī and Śuka watching.
